test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 13 Sept 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which of the following is the best definition of 'biodegradable' ?

options.text: Capable of depolymerization into carbon dioxide and water by the action of enzymes
A suitable and sufficient nutrient source for growth to saprophytic organisms
Easily digested into smaller molecules by action of bacteria or bacterial enzymes
Capable of being broken down into harmless products by the action of microbes

solution:
The correct answer is __**Capable of being broken down into harmless products by the action of microbes**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** Biodegradable Waste/Products-

 
• A biodegradable substance is one that are capable of being broken down into harmless products by the action of microbes.
 
• Microorganisms and other abiotic influences work together to degrade complex compounds into simpler organic matter that gradually suspends and fades into the soil.(degraded by natural factors such as microbes bacteria, fungi, and a few others and abiotic elements such as temperature, UV, oxygen, and so on.)
